steps.text: The Pico 2 W sits across the channel in rows 1-20, with its USB connector toward row 1. The labels show each pin's number and name.
Pin numbers start at 1 next to the USB connector on the left side, and count down the left side to 20. Click pin 1.

expect.hint: Pin 1 is the top-left pin, closest to the USB connector.

steps.text: The numbers continue on the right side going up: pin 21 is at the bottom right and pin 40 at the top right. Click pin 40.

expect.hint: Pin 40 is the top-right pin, opposite pin 1.
expect.success: Correct, pin 40 is VBUS (the 5 V from USB).

expect.hint: Pin 21 is at the bottom of the right side, opposite pin 20.
expect.success: Yes, pin 21 is opposite pin 20. Left side counts down, right side counts up.
